create_AudioGoalDataset: create an AudioGoalDataset instance with scene graphs, scenes, and split for pretraining audio-goal navigation
compute_audiogoal: compute a binaural audiogoal by convolving a source sound with a binaural room impulse response
compute_spectrogram: compute a log-magnitude STFT spectrogram from a binaural audiogoal with channel reduction
compute_goal_xy: compute goal x-y coordinates from delta position and orientation angle in Cartesian or polar form
load_source_sounds: load source sound files from disk into memory at 16kHz sampling rate for convolution
